verdicts.reason: A and B look the same: each scales the original's centred wordmark and two mirrored illustration clusters down to 320x50. The 'CREATIVE AGENCY' line ends up about 7 px tall and hard to read. The illustration clusters are cropped and crowd the canvas edges, and the figures are too small to make out. Neither candidate rearranges anything, so both are faithful but cramped scale-downs, and I can't see a meaningful difference between them.
